?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:7997
Court No. - 90
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 47552 of 2023
Applicant :- Harish Kumar Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Suhel Ahmad,Taj Uddin Siddiqui

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the entire proceedings of N.B.W. dated 30.05.2023 as well as N.B.W.+82 Cr.P.C.+ N.S. dated 23.06.2023 in Case No. 1519 of 2000 (Smt. Sarita Vs. Harish Kumar Srivastava) arising out of Complaint No. 848 of 1996, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A, 406 I.P.C., P.S. Kotwali Urai, District Jalaun, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun (Urai).
3.

After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant.

sentences.text: Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicant to approach the court concerned for bail.
In order to enable the applicant to approach the court concerned for bail, for a period of 15 days, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case, the bail application is preferred by the applicant before the court concerned, the court concerned shall decide the same expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any party.

6. In the event, applicant does not surrender before the court concerned within 15 days from today,
the police authorities and the court below are directed to ensure the execution of the warrant in accordance with law.
7. The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty and direction.

opennyai_summary.decision:
After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicant to approach the court concerned for bail.
In order to enable the applicant to approach the court concerned for bail, for a period of 15 days, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case, the bail application is preferred by the applicant before the court concerned, the court concerned shall decide the same expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any party.
6. In the event, applicant does not surrender before the court concerned within 15 days from today,
the police authorities and the court below are directed to ensure the execution of the warrant in accordance with law.
7. The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty and direction.
